title: Same words 'Do not fear' recalled by both men under hypnosis
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Same words 'Do not fear' recalled by both men under hypnosis, about November 1977 at Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Do not fear. Two men, two rooms, hours apart, neither an earshot of the other. The same three words. Words Mario has attached to his memory since 1977.
I brought up Mario and Michael because they heard do not fear over and over again before their abduction.
tellings.difference: Says they heard it over and over before the abduction, and does not mention hypnosis.
tellings.link_reason: Both men, Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, hearing 'do not fear' during the 1977 Ellsworth abduction.

as_told.title: Mario and Michael heard "do not fear" before their abduction
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels tells of two Air Force men, Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, who say they were abducted near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in November 1977. He says that under hypnosis, in separate rooms hours apart and out of earshot of each other, both recalled the same three words, "Do not fear." In a later episode he says instead that they heard those words over and over before the abduction, without mentioning hypnosis, and he tells it because two matching memories would suggest a shared real experience.
